description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Hono's tenant API when using a file-based registry. It extends an abstract class and provides a default filename for the tenants configuration JSON file.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantsConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class for tenants stored in a file. Provides default filename and inherits configuration behavior from an abstract class.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Returns the default filename for the tenants JSON configuration, overridden from the abstract superclass.
